So total tickets available = total capacity - seats for graduates - seats for faculty = 6000 - 950 - 300 = 4750 seats left for guests (friends/family). These tickets are to be divided equally among the 950 graduates. So each graduate gets 4750 / 950 = 5 tickets. Check: 950*5 = 4750. So answer is 5.
